passages.name: Line 1
passages.text:
Wilfred: A little further now… that creepy doctor’s place should be around here.

[[Line 2]]

passages.name: Line 2
passages.text:
Wilfred: Why did Father ever associate himself with that man? And why is his place so damn far from the village!?

[[Line 3]]

passages.name: Line 3
passages.text:
Wilfred: No no, it’s quite alright. The village WANTS me to save Winifred. They’re relying on me.

[[Line 4]]

passages.name: Line 5
passages.text:
Wilfred: What is that fur-ball in the the middle of the road? Is that a cat? Wait the collar! Is that…?

[[Line 6]]

passages.name: Line 6
passages.text:
Wilfred: Meone!? What are you doing in a place like this!?

[[Line 7]]

passages.name: Line 8
passages.text:
Wilfred: Did you not vanish after mother…?

[[Line 9]]

passages.name: Line 10
passages.text:
Wilfred: So many questions but Winifred cannot save herself. Many apologise Meone, but I must hurry.

[[Line 11]]

passages.name: Line 11
passages.text:
Wilfred: Head home Meone. It’s too dangerous out here.


[[Line 12]]

passages.name: Line 14
passages.text: Wilfred: It is too dangerous for you. you cannot fight! Come back please!
